summary: The 8-K reports the registrant (Stone Point Credit Income Fund) entering into a revolving credit and security agreement for its subsidiary SPCIF Funding II LLC. The agreement provides up to $200 million (expandable to $750M), matures May 31, 2031, with interest at 3-month Term SOFR plus 1.90% (increasing by 0.125% after the revolving period). This is a routine debt facility not a special situation transaction.
